title: Projects
empty: No projects yet. Add the folder you have open, or pick one from disk.
name: Name
languagesHint: Comma-separated, e.g. "C#, ShaderLab". Leave empty to detect automatically.
syncNotFetched: Compared with the last local fetch only (git fetch is disabled or failed, e.g. no network or credentials).
syncFetched: Remote fetched at the last refresh.
colorHint: Pick a swatch, use the colour dialog, or type a hex value. Empty = inherit the collection colour.
deleteCollectionConfirm: Delete this collection? Its projects stay on the dashboard.
removeProjectConfirm: Remove this project from the dashboard? Files on disk are not touched.
pathExists: This folder is already on the dashboard.
addRecentNone: Every recent project is already on the dashboard.
driveOfflineHint: The drive or network share with this project is not available. The last known details are shown.
folderDeletedHint: The drive is connected, but this folder is gone. Edit the path or remove the project.
